body:
Joe Croftcheck is the supplier Dan names as **"the family plug"** — the
Uniontown connection the household used, and the source of the quarter ounce of
cocaine bought on [[wiki/timeline/events/franki-fireworks-day-2013|the Franki
fireworks day]] in early July 2013 with $350 taken from
[[wiki/people/suzanne-frank|Suz]]'s ATM card. That single transaction is the
only dated dealing with him anywhere in the record, and it is the **earliest
dated purchase from a named supplier in the entire corpus** — five years before
[[wiki/people/johnny-dealer|Johnny]], who [[wiki/mind/synthesis/supply-network]]
had treated as the chain's first documented node.

The phrase Dan uses is what makes the page worth writing. Every other node in
the supply network is sought, peer-sourced, or friendship-embedded — Johnny,
Teddy, Tom, Menore, Sam, Vaughn. Croftcheck is described as **the family's**,
which places the earliest link in the chain in the one category the rest of the
network never occupies: **inherited rather than selected**. Whether that phrase
means the household as a whole had an established relationship with him, or
simply that he was locally known and available, the capture does not say, and
it should not be assumed.

## The federal cases

The capture cites three published news items — a 2015 *Herald-Standard* report
on a federal forfeiture action against money seized from a Uniontown
businessman in a drug raid, a Department of Justice release on 46 southwestern
Pennsylvania residents charged in a Fayette County-based cocaine and heroin
conspiracy, and a January 2016 *Post-Gazette* report on 19 indicted on federal
cocaine and heroin charges.

**These have not been verified against the sources themselves**, and the capture
does not state which case names him or in what role. What is recorded here is
therefore the operator's own association of Croftcheck with that enforcement
wave, dated to the mid-2010s and to Fayette County — not a finding about charges,
conviction, or any specific person named in those filings. The distinction
matters: an unverified association with a federal drug case is exactly the kind
of claim that should not harden by being repeated inside a wiki.

## Gaps

- **Nothing is verified.** No message thread, no court record, and no direct
  corroboration of any kind exists on disk for this person. The whole page rests
  on one 2026 capture describing a 2013 event.
- **"The family plug" is unexplained.** Whether the relationship ran through
  Suz, through Rick, through the wider household, or was simply the local
  option, is unknown, and the answer would materially change what this node
  means for [[wiki/mind/synthesis/supply-network]].
- **The date range of the relationship is unknown.** One transaction is
  documented; whether it was the first, the only, or one of many is not.
- **The news citations are unchecked.** Reading the three linked articles would
  establish whether he is named at all, which is the single cheapest thing that
  could be done to this page.
